The Painful Reality

The "December Panic" Method

  • Staring at a Blank Appraisal Box

    Paralysis sets in as you struggle to recall what you accomplished 6 months ago, leading to generic and underplayed self-reviews.

  • Frantic Scanning of Slack & Git

    Wasting hours scrolling through hundreds of Slack channels, git logs, and calendar items on December 15th to find raw proof.

  • Recency Bias Minimizes Your Wins

    Only remembering the tasks completed in the last 2 weeks, while major achievements from Q1 and Q2 are completely forgotten.

  • Underplayed Impact = Missed Promotions

    Writing a modest appraisal because you lack structural data, letting others who write assertive reviews secure the raises.

Enterprise-Grade Security & Row-Level Isolation

Your career logs are encrypted at rest and in transit. By combining JWT tokens, strict database Row-Level Security (RLS), and sandboxed API pathways, we ensure your achievements are visible to you, and only you.

Privacy-first architecture

Your accomplishments belong to you. Period.

Unlike many AI tools, Impactly AI never aggregates your private logs, trains large language models on your entries, or shares corporate documentation. Every check-in is encrypted and locked in your isolated database tenancy.
